# 太上洞神五星讚--張衡

**ID:** KR5c0376
**Custom ID:** ZB5c0366

## Authors / Editors
- 張衡 78 - 139

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Most High Dòngshén Hymns to the Five Planets*

attributed to [張衡](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%B5%E8%A1%A1) (Zhāng Héng)

A short Daoist **hymnal** (*zàn* 讚) to the **Five Planets** (*wǔ xīng* 五星), pseudepigraphically attributed to Zhāng Héng (either the Eastern-Hàn polymath Zhāng Héng 張衡 78–139, or Zhāng Héng the second Celestial Master, son of [張道陵](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BC%B5%E9%81%93%E9%99%B5)). Preserved as **DZ 976** / CT 976 (*Dòngshén bù, Zàn sòng lèi* 洞神部讚頌類).

**Dating.** Six Dynasties to Táng. Dynasty: 六朝-唐.
